consequence.statement: The release note only announces a new capability for HelmRelease creation; it describes no failure, rejection, ignored setting, permission change, or altered behaviour for existing configurations, so an operator who does nothing simply gains the new option.
consequence.remediation: Operators wanting a custom storage namespace for new HelmReleases can use the new capability; nothing must be done otherwise.

assertion.statement: Flux 2.7.0 adds support for specifying a custom storage namespace when creating a HelmRelease; the release note does not name the flag or field that implements this capability.

proposal.undeterminedReason: subject: The evidence names the capability ("custom storage namespace in HelmRelease creation") but not its implementing identity: no CLI flag, HelmRelease field path, or other subject name appears in the text, and no artifact context is provided to settle the spelling, so no family/name can be asserted.; applicability: No environment predicate can be derived: the implementing flag/field and any preconditions are not named in the evidence, and no effect on existing configurations is described, so there is nothing static to test an environment against.
